candidate.answerReason: Testing bulb lifetimes consumes the tested bulbs. Sampling obtains information without using up the whole batch.

methods.label: Recognize destructive testing
methods.explanation: Service life testing is destructive, so sampling is appropriate instead of testing every product.
methods.levelReason: The elementary distinction between a census and a sample is sufficient.
